newsitem.title: USA: Lilly in last phase of plant consolidation.
newsitem.headline: Lilly in last phase of plant consolidation.

text.p: Lilly Industries Inc said Tuesday it will begin the final phase of consolidating two Los Angeles-area coatings manufacturing facilities.
The consolidation will take place over the next six months, the company said.

Lilly is moving all manufacturing from its Southgate, Calif., facility to its Montebello plant. Previously, all administrative, technical, sales and marketing functions had been shifted to Montebello from Southgate.

"Improved efficiencies in raw material procurement, inventory management, manufactuing and customer service will position Lilly as a stronger supplier for the future in the California and greater Southwest markets," the company said in a statement.
Lilly provides industrial coatings and specialty chemicals products.
